title: Construction and underlying diagram of pointed etale base change
statement: Let A,B,K,L be commutative rings in one universe with A- and B-algebra structures on K and L. Let π:A → B be a ring map, and let H be the pushout extension-of-scalars functor of [lem-sbc-surjective-quotient-base-change]. Base change sends every etale A-algebra S to an etale B-algebra H(S). Given a B-algebra map c:H(K) → L, form the functor on pointed etale algebras [def-sc-ring-strict-henselization] by applying H to S → K and composing with c. Its underlying algebra diagram is canonically isomorphic to extension of scalars of the original diagram.

proof.text: Apply RingHom.Etale.isStableUnderBaseChange, converted to categorical cobase-change stability, to the defining pushout. This proves the etaleness of its B-structure map.
Use Over.post H, Over.map c and ObjectProperty.lift to construct the pointed functor. The definitions of these functors leave the underlying algebra unchanged, so the comparison is Iso.refl.
